propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit deterministic signed pins binding to direct children and prerequisites with canonical ticket IDs and material fingerprints.
Plan-material-pin manifest lines must appear in deterministic order after verified-at-sha and before dependencies, with roles child or prerequisite sorted lexicographically by role then ID.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived tickets to discover arbitrary inbound blockers before LLM evaluation, raising PlanRelationSnapshotError with exact structured reasons for missing/unresolvable targets.

tracker_head_sha() must capture clean tickets-tracker HEAD as 40-hex SHA after ensure_fresh, detecting dirty/unmerged state via git status and ls-files, raising store-read-failure for all git/IO/path/subprocess failures.

All plan-review signing paths (sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must collect pins via relation_snapshot.collect_plan_relation_snapshot() and pass related_material to build_manifest before attestation generation.
Legacy manifest readers must authenticate complete stored manifests including unknown pin lines without reconstruction, preserving backward compatibility for pre-feature pinless attestations.
